name: taskband
description: A slim band above the prompt with the progress of the current task, what it used in creds (by Claude Code's own cost), the 5-hour limit and a prompt-cache countdown that, once cold or after a model switch, shows what the next send costs in creds on the model it goes to; on the desktop a small clock beside it says when it goes cold, its ring draining smoothly with the cache; the row's bars slide to new lengths and the task's shimmers while Claude works; after a compaction the band counts the new context size at once; /keepwarm keeps the cache warm through breaks with small pings (they cost tokens); a chevron opens the step list, both limits, the turn's cost and its use of each limit, the context window and a Compact button

cacheMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a request. 60 on a subscription; 5 once the session is billed as extra usage.

cacheAlert.title: Cache cooling notice
cacheAlert.description: Send a notification when the prompt cache has five minutes left. The countdown turns red and pulses either way.

autoWarm.title: Auto keepwarm
autoWarm.description: on: after a send pays to write a cold cache again, keepwarm holds it warm for three hours by itself. off: keepwarm runs only when you arm it with /keepwarm. Pings cost tokens.

finishSound.title: Sound when a long turn ends
finishSound.description: Play a short Windows chime when a turn that took a minute or more finishes.
